title: Complete Printer and Computer Workstation
description: One complete static technology fabrication demonstration workstation scene: the entire original open worktable supports the entire original single-column cantilever printer on its left and the entire original fixed-open portable computer on its right. All three complete previous model IDs retain their full original GLB buffer payloads, per-face materials, normals and internal hierarchy with unit-scale rigid translations only. Both complete device envelopes lie on the real finite table top with an open gap between their stations; the table has a clear front under-table opening and stands on one finite scene-only floor. This layout is not the communications bench/cable reel/mast service bay or the carpentry joint/plane/rack scene. One scene, zero new independent models. No operating printer, connected computer, wiring, fabrication process, worker, loading, ergonomic or electrical/safety assertion.
